lede.zh: 本报告记录 MiniMax-M2.7 W8A8 QuaRot 在昇腾 910B4 上的闭环场景、Agent 轨迹、开环容量 SLO 与批次预算敏感性。
lede.en: This report covers closed-loop workloads, Agent replay, open-loop capacity SLO, and batch-budget sensitivity for MiniMax-M2.7 W8A8 QuaRot on Ascend 910B4.

snapshot.zh: 6 个闭环场景 · 9 档开放环速率 · 预登记 safe_rps 2.25
snapshot.en: 6 closed-loop profiles · 9 open-loop rates · preregistered safe_rps 2.25

heading.zh: 明确区分闭环峰值与开环容量
heading.en: Separate closed-loop peaks from open-loop capacity

intro.zh: 所有数据对应 MiniMax-M2.7 W8A8 QuaRot 与列出的 910B4 服务配置。闭环场景、开环到达率和 Agent 轨迹反映不同负载，不能合成一个吞吐分数。
intro.en: All results apply to MiniMax-M2.7 W8A8 QuaRot with the listed 910B4 setup. Closed-loop profiles, open-loop arrival rates, and Agent traces are different workloads and should not be combined into one throughput score.

note.zh: 安全速率采用开跑前冻结的 TTFT P95 ≤ 2,000 ms 判据；TTFT 尾延迟复测波动较高，因此结论保留明确的复测规则与误差边界。
note.en: Safe rate follows the preregistered TTFT P95 ≤ 2,000 ms criterion; TTFT tail latency varied across reruns, so the conclusion retains its repeat rule and uncertainty boundary.

heading.zh: 短请求、长上下文与 Agent 轨迹体现不同服务画像
heading.en: Short requests, long context, and Agent replay produce distinct serving profiles

intro.zh: vLLM-Ascend 0.23.0rc1，TP8 + EP，EAGLE3 k=3；闭环测试覆盖延迟、高生成量、长上下文、ShareGPT、吞吐与 Agent。
intro.en: vLLM-Ascend 0.23.0rc1, TP8 + EP, EAGLE3 k=3; closed-loop profiles include latency, high generation, long context, ShareGPT, throughput, and Agent.

notes.zh: Agent 为 16 个会话、235 个请求，前缀命中率 91.51%；轨迹回放没有执行真实工具，不能解读为 Agent 任务成功率。
notes.en: Agent uses 16 sessions and 235 requests with 91.51% prefix-hit rate; trace replay does not call live tools and is not Agent task success.

notes.zh: 图中场景请求形状不同，只用于定位本次各负载观测值，不作为单一并发等级横向排名。
notes.en: The profiles use different request shapes; the chart locates observations from this campaign and is not a ranking at one common concurrency.

title.zh: 闭环场景：输出与输入吞吐
title.en: Closed-loop profiles: output and input throughput

heading.zh: 512/256 负载的可复测速率边界为每副本 2.25 req/s
heading.en: The repeatable rate boundary for 512/256 traffic is 2.25 req/s per replica

intro.zh: 泊松到达，512 输入 / 256 输出，每档约 300 秒。TTFT P95 ≤ 2,000 ms 为预登记主 SLO；2.4 与 2.6 req/s 边界各做两次复测。
intro.en: Poisson arrivals, 512 input / 256 output, about 300 seconds per point. The preregistered primary SLO is TTFT P95 ≤ 2,000 ms; boundary rates 2.4 and 2.6 req/s were each repeated twice.

notes.zh: 2.25 req/s 实测档两次 TTFT P95 均达标；2.42 req/s 实测档两次均超阈。预登记结论 safe_rps=2.25，但 TTFT P95 复测波动较大，阈值是本环境的容量判据，不是普适 SLA。
notes.en: Both runs at 2.25 achieved the TTFT P95 threshold; both at 2.42 exceeded it. The preregistered safe_rps conclusion is 2.25, but TTFT P95 has notable run-to-run variation; this is an environment-specific capacity criterion, not a universal SLA.

title.zh: 开放环：到达率与输出吞吐
title.en: Open loop: arrival rate and output throughput

body.zh: 复测的 TTFT P95 相对极差为 8.6%–22.9%，明显高于吞吐速率本身的波动。因此边界结论按两次复测是否一致制定，不能将单次 2.4 点读成稳定容量保证。
body.en: TTFT P95 relative range across repeats is 8.6%–22.9%, much higher than rate variation. The boundary conclusion uses agreement across both repeated runs; a single 2.4 point is not a stable capacity guarantee.

heading.zh: 调整批次预算会重排 ITL 延迟分布，未显著提高总吞吐
heading.en: Changing batch-token budget reshapes ITL distribution without materially raising aggregate throughput

intro.zh: 同一权重与服务硬件，固定 32K 输入 / 128 输出、并发 16；对照 max-num-batched-tokens 8K / 16K / 32K。
intro.en: Same checkpoint and serving hardware, fixed 32K input / 128 output at concurrency 16; max-num-batched-tokens compared at 8K / 16K / 32K.

notes.zh: 该实验支持“延迟方差与中位数之间的分配旋钮”这一观察，不支持其作为提速选项；总吞吐与 ITL 均值在约 ±3.6% 内。
notes.en: The experiment supports viewing this as a trade-off between latency variance and median, not as a speed-up option; aggregate throughput and mean ITL stayed within about ±3.6%.

heading.zh: 轨迹前缀复用较高，EAGLE3 接受长度约 2.4–2.6
heading.en: Trace replay shows high prefix reuse and EAGLE3 acceptance length around 2.4–2.6

intro.zh: Agent C8 使用 16 会话 235 请求；EAGLE3 k=3。投机计数器按可审计窗口汇总。
intro.en: Agent C8 uses 16 sessions and 235 requests; EAGLE3 k=3. Speculation counters are reported only for auditable windows.

notes.zh: 仅公布可自洽的计数器窗口；启动到延迟档窗口混有已作废试跑，不作为正式接受率结果。
notes.en: Only internally consistent counter windows are reported; the startup-to-latency window contains retracted trials and is not presented as a formal acceptance result.

rows: 高生成量 + 长上下文（合并窗口）

methodIntro.zh: 单机 8×Ascend 910B4，TP8 + EP；闭环测试与容量测试来自同一权重的两轮完成实验。
methodIntro.en: One system with eight Ascend 910B4 accelerators, TP8 + EP; closed-loop and capacity tests come from two completed campaigns for the same checkpoint.

methodNotes.zh: 大批量 ShareGPT / 吞吐档的 TTFT 受排队影响，是队列等待时间，不应与 C1 延迟档直接比较。长上下文档的重点是输入预填充吞吐。
methodNotes.en: TTFT in large-batch ShareGPT/throughput profiles includes queueing and should not be compared directly with C1 latency. The long-context profile emphasizes input prefill throughput.

methodNotes.zh: 重复测试发现 TTFT P95 波动明显；safe_rps 按两次边界复测一致性确定。原始主机地址、内部节点名、权重目录、日志和凭据已省略。
methodNotes.en: Reruns showed notable TTFT P95 variation; safe_rps uses agreement across two boundary repeats. Source addresses, internal node names, checkpoint directories, logs, and credentials are omitted.
